Man Dies in Shark Attack Off Australian Beach

A man has died after a shark attack at Sorrento Beach, north of Perth, in Western Australia. The incident occurred in front of beachgoers. This is the fifth fatal shark attack in Australia this year. Authorities searched for the swimmer following the attack, with a shark reportedly sighted in the area. The attack follows a recent incident where a surfer was bitten in the same state.
